content.title: Management Summary
content.content:
SnapLogic is an enterprise integration platform enabling {{customer_name}} to modernize data integration while maintaining strict data sovereignty requirements. This vendor profile demonstrates SnapLogic's qualification across key evaluation criteria.

**Vendor Qualification Highlights:**

[KPI:blue|Company Founded|2006]
[KPI:jade|Global Customers|600+]
[KPI:orange|Annual Data Processed|5B+ documents/month]
[KPI:navy|Enterprise Employees|21+ at $1M+ ARR|]

**Key Strengths for {{customer_name}}:**

- **Enterprise Maturity**: Founded 2006, $100M+ ARR milestone reached August 2025, 21+ customers spending $1M+ annually
- **On-Premises Capability**: Ground Plex architecture provides true on-premises execution with no cloud data transit — ideal for {{country}} data residency requirements
- **Aerospace Manufacturing Experience**: Proven deployments in aerospace and defense verticals with complex compliance and security requirements
- **Financial Stability**: Backed by institutional investors (Andreessen Horowitz, Salesforce Ventures, Capital One Ventures) with consistent ARR growth
- **Professional Services**: 40+ PS consultants globally across AMER and EMEA, with DACH-region delivery capability for German-language support
- **Certifications**: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR compliant — meets aerospace manufacturing security standards

**Informatica Migration Expertise:**

SnapLogic was founded by Gaurav Dhillon, who previously co-founded Informatica. The company has deep heritage in enterprise data integration and has completed 50+ Informatica migration projects. SnapLogic provides automated conversion tools and proven methodologies for transitioning from Informatica PowerCenter to the SnapLogic platform.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.06.40.png:Vendor Profile Overview Dashboard]

**Document Structure:**

This vendor profile addresses {{customer_name}}'s qualification requirements across three primary areas:

- **Section 1: Vendor Profile & Experience** — Company overview, leadership, financial stability, aerospace experience, certifications, and professional services capability
- **Section 2: Platform Overview** — Technical architecture, on-premises deployment model, security controls, and data governance capabilities
- **Section 3: Requirements Response Matrix** — Detailed response to all vendor qualification requirements with supporting evidence
- **Appendix C: Citizen Integrator User Story** — Demonstration of low-code capabilities enabling business analysts to build integration pipelines
